scope: PL whole-plan control/compiler/dependency/ACL/generation/drain candidate; closed 68-program control and real layout/vector data chains; no synthesis/STA/board/whole CASE.

confirmed.fact: Sealed V022 image contains 68 closed CONV/FFN programs, 636 original nodes, 45055 instructions and 6231 matrix descriptors.
The 68 programs have zero tensor-name dependencies; all 68 are roots and leaves; all inputs are produced outside the closed set.
All 2278 unordered program pairs overlap in DDR (WAW/RAW/WAR); root-parallel dispatch is unsafe.
Temporary arenas overlap; peak 36 live temp ranges; 994 overlapping pairs; compile_pl_plans.py uses per-program temp bases.
A 4416-byte WCPL superplan with 68 real program pointers, 128-bit dependency masks and FNV-1a hash compiles and verifies.
The compiled 68-node plan runs under a SEQ stub with one START, 68 dispatches, one DONE/IRQ and zero errors in Icarus and Verilator.
Real layout->vector->vector and real V022 layout+vector data chains match an independent Python float32 golden on 64/64 words.
Generation loss, bad hash, bad VEC ACL, child fault with drain, START replay and parameter-window writes are rejected/guarded.
One-START control reduces 68 per-program starts to 1 (68-node control: 1372 vs 2505 cycles).
The candidate top needs one more AXI master than the current 5-master plans block, or a shared fetch arbiter.
Board PL traffic uses ps/S_AXI_HP0_FPD; PS CPU is out of data path but the PS hard DDR controller is not bypassed.
CSR passes 39 control checks; compiler format passes 200 random DAGs plus negative cycle/hash/129-node tests.

assumptions: The sealed manifest/image and V022 plans are the intended read-only baseline; no weight/plan content was changed.
The 68-node serial order uses the manifest/topological root order; it is a control-safe serialization, not a proven semantic whole-CASE order.
The BFM is a logic model with deterministic+random stalls; it is not a board DDR timing model.
The before/after 4-program cycle comparison aligns BFM port indices/seed but not full host/network latency; no CASE-time extrapolation.
Generation=0 in the 68-node artifact means ignore; production must bind the sealed generation.
No matrix arithmetic or vendor FMA is used as evidence in this task.
untested: Whole CASE0000 execution and strict ONNX comparison.
Matrix W7/A16/C48 arithmetic through the whole plan (external engine only control-stubbed here).
Outside 591 legacy queues / 593 descriptors and the upstream FusionExecutor/ONNX model.
Synthesis, STA at 300/600 MHz, DRC, bitstream, board, VNC/network deployment.
True bypass of the PS hard DDR controller (needs MIG/external adapter).
Parallel execution of the 68 programs without arena relocation.

coverage.whole_case_reason: 68 closed programs are disjoint islands: all 68 inputs are produced outside the closed set; 591 legacy queues/593 descriptors remain in the host DAG (quoted from work/CURRENT_WORK.txt). A single START here would read tensors not yet produced.

limitations: No wholecase; no board/STA; matrix/FMA untested; outside DAG missing.
Control scan is combinational over up to 128 nodes; no registered/pipelined scan or 300/600 MHz STA.
